copyright.title: Imininingwane Yokukopisha Nokuqukethwe
copyright.section1.title: Imithombo Yokuqukethwe Nezimiso
copyright.section1.body: ToonStudio iyinkomba kanye ne-discovery platform ehlanganisa imethadatha yomphakathi yekhathalogi (izihloko, ababhali, izinhlobo, njll.) kusuka kuma-webtoon / ama-webnovel platform. Ayibambi noma ihlukanise kabusha okuqukethwe kwesigaba esikhulu; ukufunda kuqondiswa kuphela ngezixhumanisi ezisemthethweni.
copyright.section2.title: Izithombe Zesembozo
copyright.section2.body: Izithombe zesembozo zisebenza njengezithonjana zokukhomba futhi zibhekisela ezembozweni zangempela zepulatifomu ngezixhumanisi zomthombo lapho kungenzeka. Izikrini zingavinjelwa ngokushesha ngesicelo somnikazi wamalungelo noma izibuyekezo zenqubomgomo.
copyright.section3.title: Amamethrikhi Nokwenza Okucacile
copyright.section4.title: Isaziso Samalungelo
copyright.section5.title: Isaziso sokwephulwa kwe-copyright & ukuthathwa
copyright.section5.body: Uma ukholelwa ukuthi imethadatha noma izihloko zokumboza ziphula amalungelo akho, sicela uthumele umbuzo onesihloko, i-URL nobufakazi bobunikazi.
